subject.title: feat(discord/voice): add sessionChannelId to autoJoin for text-channel transcript routing

question: Should Discord voice text mirroring be modeled as per-autoJoin `sessionChannelId`, an extension of `voice.agentSession`, or a broader voice-as-I/O design?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the permanent public config surface overlaps an existing shipped `voice.agentSession` route and affects Discord voice delivery semantics.

options.title: Extend `voice.agentSession`
options.body: Use the existing target-session surface as the canonical route and add explicit transcript/reply mirroring semantics there if maintainers want visible text output.

options.title: Accept per-autoJoin target
options.body: Review or replace the linked fork PR around `autoJoin.sessionChannelId`, with same-guild validation, delivery semantics, docs, upgrade proof, and live Discord proof before merge.

options.title: Reopen broader bridge design
options.body: Treat this issue as a narrow satellite and first settle speaker attribution, target selection, and tool-access policy in the broader Discord voice-as-I/O design.

recommendation.title: Extend `voice.agentSession`
recommendation.body: Use the existing target-session surface as the canonical route and add explicit transcript/reply mirroring semantics there if maintainers want visible text output.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the clearest live review context and recent history on the Discord voice config/routing boundary.
